title: Map Wgpu Renderer Parity
description: Restore full premigration map (gis2d) functionality in the wgpu renderer: Vello-rendered cartography, tile fetching, hover, rectangle+lasso multi-select, middle-button pan, context menu, layer weight sliders.
summary: Restored full GIS map functionality in the wgpu-native renderer: GisMapScene + build_gis_map_scene in framework core; engine_canvas MapHost registry with Vello offscreen paint, tile fetch queue/apply, wheel/pan/marquee/hover helpers; scenes render_gis_map with marquee overlay and context menu; AppRuntime pointer/wheel dispatch and asset-poll tile fetching (wasm fetch + native ureq); gis2d plugin switched from canvas-2d placeholders to gis2d-map with extended runtime/commands (selection merge modes, hover, focus, openSource, layer stroke scales) and inspector weight sliders; MapHost focus_feature + open_url in gis_2d. Verified: cargo check semio-framework-renderer-wgpu (exit 0), gis2d plugin 14/14 tests pass.
